purpose: Design of the eight doc-link SKILLs and two custom Agents: responsibilities, use cases, per-SKILL sequences, the operation flow, and the data exchange with Agents.
summary: Composition table of eight SKILLs (embed-dlid, index-docs, query-docs, resolve-dlid, check-dlid, check-links, check-toc, check-impact) with write permissions and requirement mapping
Custom Agents toc-updater (information generation) and query-worker (search) with responsibilities and callers
Responsibilities of operation and lookup SKILLs
Responsibilities of inspection SKILLs, what each detects and how the project management AI handles findings
check-impact output: changed documents with direct referrers, recorded content hash versus current hash, no indirect referrers
Use case diagram for users, the project management AI and caller skills
Sequence diagrams for each SKILL, including embed-dlid, index-docs, query-docs and resolve-dlid
Operation flow common to introduction and later changes: check-dlid, embed-dlid, check-links, index-docs, check-impact, with user confirmation for writes
Procedure for writing a reference with resolve-dlid and when index-docs is needed
Request and result exchange with custom Agents: identifiers, limits, error values, script validation, deletion timing
tasks: Implementing or modifying a doc-link SKILL
Implementing or modifying the toc-updater or query-worker Agent
Reviewing the SKILL and Agent design against requirements
Deciding the order in which to run SKILLs after introduction or changes
Handling findings of check-dlid, check-links, check-toc or check-impact
Designing data exchange between a SKILL and an Agent
title: DES-010 SKILL と Agent の構成
